text:
nina: deploy-bot blocked the promo for release 2026.03.21. preflight failed: artifact pull returned 404 from edge cache but origin shows blob present. blocking the cut.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion blocked: registry-edge-404 for gcr.redwood-inference/prod/release-2026.03.21. Preflight job `preflight-12` failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood/integration/1800100000/logs

omar: edge 404 + origin present sounds like TTL/GC drift on the CDN or inconsistent object generation. Did we recently run lifecycle GC?

sre-oncall: we had a GC sweep last night in eu-west1 that pruned unreferenced generations. I see the blob origin generation id changed at 02:10 UTC after a compose reupload, edge still has older generation cached which is now GC'd. I can trigger edge invalidation and replicate the latest generation.

tara: if we invalidate and push, some regions may briefly serve 404s during repopulation. Maybe safer to pin the release to the older generation if it's still available in origin snapshots. That avoids mass invalidation during the change window.

nina: pros/cons: pin to older generation -> quick promo but risk that origin snapshot expires later. Invalidate+replicate -> avoids pin but risks transient 404s to users if canaries hit lagging edges.

sre-oncall: quick check: older generation exists in backup snapshots for 48hrs. We can pin to the older generation id sha256:1122aabb, promote, then schedule a background replication to edges. I'll also annotate the artifact as "pinned-by-release-team" to prevent later GC.

omar: command for pin (dry-run):
```bash
deployctl promote --repo prod --manifest-digest sha256:1122aabb --reason "pin older gen after edge TTL drift"
```

tara: vote: pin + replicate. we'll avoid changing CDN invalidation during change window. also update release-notes: "Promotion delayed for artifact consistency; pinned to last-available generation and verifying edge replication."

nina: approved. omar, can you run the promote? SRE, please ensure snapshot annotation stops GC.

omar: starting promote now. will run post-promote region-verify (curl from three regions).

sre-oncall: annotated snapshot to prevent GC and kicked a replication job. ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion queued: promote --repo prod --manifest-digest sha256:1122aabb --requester omar

omar: promote output:
2026-03-21T17:05:11Z promote: resolved sha256:1122aabb
2026-03-21T17:05:18Z promote: applied pin, awaiting post-promote verification

tara: running region-verify now. will report back.

sre-oncall: replication reported healthy for us-west1 and eu-west1; ap-south still warming (5m left).

tara: verification: us-west1 OK, eu-west1 OK, ap-south returns manifest after retry. Looks good.

nina: decision record: pin to sha256:1122aabb, annotate artifact to prevent GC, replicate edges in background, delay automated canary until replication verified. Follow-up: postmortem ticket to upload pipeline to make finalizes atomic.

omar: publishing short note to #release-notes now.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion complete (manual proceed required for canary). state: pinned-digest=sha256:1122aabb, edge-replication=warming, post-verify=passed in two regions.

nina: final: manual canary enable at 17:20 UTC, monitor 25m, then full rollout. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:
